title: Ousama Game
overview:
Pick an idol from two discs -> versus battle -> win -> order a penalty game -> total satisfaction!!

Ousama Game is a collection of minigames starring eight real Japanese gravure idols. The cast is split across two discs: four idols on the Strawberry disc and four on the Peach disc. Choose the idol you want to face, beat her in a head-to-head minigame battle, and as the winner you get to play king and order her to carry out a penalty game.

- Eight gravure idols in live-action photo and video footage
- Two discs: Strawberry girls and Peach girls
- Single-player variety minigames
- For ages 18 and over

2枚のディスクからアイドル選び → 対戦バトル → 勝つ → 罰ゲームを命令 → 大満足！！
